pulls.title: 6988055: Support IDNA2008
pulls.author: arnt
pulls.body_excerpt: `java.net.IDN` still implements IDNA2003, which is frozen at Unicode 3.2. This PR moves it to UTS46 (IDNA2008 with the Unicode compatibility mapping), which is what the big three browsers and most other languages' IDN libraries use. Names such as faß.de have been registrable since 2010, and today `IDN` turns that into fass.de, which is a different domain. ### Changes The implementation is ICU4J's UTS46 code, merged into `jdk.internal.icu` with the smallest reasonable diff. The UTS46 data (`uts46.nrm`) is generated from Unicode 17, the same version as `Character`, so `IDN` can follow future Uni

pulls.title: 8390358: HotCodeCollector can relocate never-sampled nmethod
pulls.author: eastig
pulls.body_excerpt: HotCodeCollector stores `nmethod*` pointers during sampling. Code blobs can be freed and reused for other nmethods in between sampling and relocation. As a result we can relocate never-sampled nmethod. I managed to create a test which reproduces the issue. However the test is not reliable to be added to jtreg tests. It depends on a host and OS is being run on. To avoid the issue, I use compile ids to distinguish nmethods. We need to dereference nmethod pointer during sampling without holding locks. We can do this because we run sampling in JavaThread and no safepoint can happen during sampling

pulls.author: shipilev
pulls.body_excerpt: This PR implements Shenandoah barrier hotpatching on C2 side, as described in the RFE. In short, we want to dynamically rewrite the "fastpath" GC state checks in nmethods to either `nop`-s (when GC is known idle) or `jump`-s (when GC is known active, and in known state). This greatly improves performance when GC is idle (= only `nop`-s are "executed"), and gives an edge when GC is active as well (no conditional branches, we know we have to go to outline stub). pulls.author: earthling-amzn
pulls.body_excerpt: When Shenandoah experiences a concurrent mode failure, it initiates a safepoint and attempts to finish the collection cycle there. This handoff between concurrent and degenerated cycles is error prone and has been the source of many, many defects. Removing degenerated cycles will simplify the code base, lower maintenance costs and allow the team to focus on more meaningful changes. Threads which cannot allocate will stall. pulls.body_excerpt: Replaces the 1. DMB ISH 2. store 3. DMB ISH sequence with STLR for volatile field stores. For example, this would apply to AtomicLong::set. pulls.title: 8374307: Fix deoptimization storm caused by Action_none in GraphKit::uncommon_trap
pulls.author: bulasevich
pulls.body_excerpt: We observed a deoptimization storm caused by GraphKit::uncommon_trap generator logic. GraphKit::uncommon_trap considers the too_many_recompiles metric. If the threshold is overflowed, it replaces Deoptimization::Action_reinterpret with Deoptimization::Action_none (see code snippet below). This replacement changes the uncommon_trap logic: once execution hits a trap, the VM performs deoptimization but does not recompile the method anymore. In an "unlucky" case, when the code part calling this uncommon_trap becomes frequent, a deoptimization storm occurs (thousands of deoptimizations per second)
